comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Left is 1 if any comment uses second-person 'you/your' directed at the OP. Right is 1 if any comment's argument is carried by third-person analysis rather than by addressing the OP directly. A comment may qualify on the right even if it also uses 'you'. The two predicates are not complements and can both be 1 for the same row. Their eligibility rules also differ.
